payload.title: The -z git listings in lift_sandbox_pin are decoded with the locale codec (text=True in hermetic_git), so a non-UTF-8 path name the seat creates raises a raw UnicodeDecodeError out of the lift instead of a named GovernanceError refusal
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:603-606 (the listings run through hermetic_git with its default text decoding)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:610-611 (the decoded stdout is split on NUL)
payload.rule_violated: A seat's untrusted output is refused by a named error, never by a crash: every refusal of the lift is a GovernanceError that names its reason
payload.notes: Registered by the D6 findings clerk from the D6 review round 1 (lens security), re-checked at head ac106b734 before registration; non-blocking at merge. Close condition: The listings are read as bytes (hermetic_git with text=False) and a path that is not valid UTF-8 is refused by name. Test: a seat file named with the byte 0xff makes the lift raise GovernanceError.
